name: SIT Ulil Albab Batam
address: Tiban Utara No.1, Patam Lestari, Sekupang, Kota Batam (kampus juga di Batu Aji)

notes.id: RA Anak Harapan Ulil Albab. DPI (dana pengembangan institusi) normal Rp3.800.000; diskon gelombang 1/2/3 = 25%/20%/10%. Total normal Rp8.720.000. Gelombang 1 bayar DPI + pendaftaran s.d. 25 Okt 2026, gelombang 2 s.d. 25 Nov 2026, gelombang 3 s.d. 25 Des 2026.
notes.en: RA Anak Harapan Ulil Albab. Institutional development fee (DPI) Rp3,800,000 normal; wave 1/2/3 discounts 25%/20%/10%. Normal total Rp8,720,000. Wave 1: pay DPI + registration by 25 Oct 2026; wave 2 by 25 Nov 2026; wave 3 by 25 Dec 2026.

notes.id: DPI normal Rp13.000.000; gelombang 1 diskon 15% (Rp11.050.000). Diskon Rp1.000.000 untuk alumni TKIT Ulil Albab. Kelas ber-AC. SPP disesuaikan saat naik ke kelas 4. Total normal Rp19.100.000.
notes.en: DPI Rp13,000,000 normal; wave 1 15% off (Rp11,050,000). Rp1,000,000 off for TKIT Ulil Albab alumni. Air-conditioned classes. Tuition is adjusted from grade 4. Normal total Rp19,100,000.

notes.id: DPI normal Rp6.000.000; gelombang 1 (1–10 Okt 2026) diskon 70%, gelombang 2 (11 Okt–20 Nov 2026) 25%, gelombang 3 10%. Diskon Rp1.000.000 untuk alumni SDIT Ulil Albab. Total normal Rp13.150.000 (putra) / Rp13.550.000 (putri).
notes.en: DPI Rp6,000,000 normal; wave 1 (1–10 Oct 2026) 70% off, wave 2 (11 Oct–20 Nov 2026) 25%, wave 3 10%. Rp1,000,000 off for SDIT Ulil Albab alumni. Normal total Rp13,150,000 (boys) / Rp13,550,000 (girls).

notes.id: Full day jalur reguler. DPI normal Rp10.000.000; gelombang 1/2/3 diskon 30%/20%/10%. Diskon Rp1.000.000 untuk alumni SMPIT Ulil Albab. Total normal Rp19.090.000 (putra). Tersedia juga program boarding.
notes.en: Full-day regular track. DPI Rp10,000,000 normal; wave 1/2/3 discounts 30%/20%/10%. Rp1,000,000 off for SMPIT Ulil Albab alumni. Normal total Rp19,090,000 (boys). A boarding programme is also offered.

period.id: Gelombang 1 bayar DPI + pendaftaran s.d. 25 Okt 2026, gelombang 2 s.d. 25 Nov 2026, gelombang 3 s.d. 25 Des 2026.
period.en: Wave 1: pay DPI + registration by 25 Oct 2026; wave 2 by 25 Nov 2026; wave 3 by 25 Dec 2026.

steps.id: Bayar uang pendaftaran dan DPI sesuai batas gelombang (pendaftaran batal jika belum dibayar)
steps.en: Pay registration and DPI by the wave deadline (unpaid registrations are cancelled)

notes.id: Jika tidak diterima, biaya dikembalikan 100%. Mundur sebelum 1 Juli 2027: potongan 50%; setelahnya tidak dikembalikan. Jalur prestasi (olimpiade, peringkat 1–3, hafalan ≥ 3 juz) mendapat bebas DPI atau cashback.
notes.en: If not accepted, fees are refunded in full. Withdrawal before 1 July 2027: 50% deduction; after that, no refund. Achievement tracks (olympiads, top-3 rank, ≥ 3 juz memorised) get DPI waivers or cashback.
